rev6.release_notes:
Fusion add-in: Train This Part / Export Model works on a new design that has never been in the Manufacture workspace (it no longer fails with "failed to find product").
Save As comes up as a .txt file; a THREAD keyword reaches a mill program's Simulate.
Lathe Simulate's stock region code matches CAD CAM's.

cadcam.release_notes:
Recognize Part: right-click a feature for the toolpaths that fit it (a bolt circle or hole: Drill, Tap, Thread Mill, Spiral Interpolate, 2D Contour), set up from the feature's own sizes and the setup that holds it.
Recognize Part: a thread only when it is modelled; a STEP file's thread callouts become threads on their faces (FROM PRINT); a part that does not turn is read by its faces; hole patterns and a turned part's milled faces read better.
Turning: an op's spindle stays Auto when you OK without touching it.
Sketch: a rectangle's size boxes keep clear of the view's buttons.
Drawings: the first section dimension no longer stalls the window; views let go of work they no longer need.
Steadier: the crash watchdog reads the stuck stacks; a refused install says so at start.
